name: Rolen Vashtir
desc:
Rolen Vashtir, first of his name, was the final King of [Etrea](faction:etrea), who reigned through the early 6th century CE.

Rolen later disappeared during an expedition into the [Voidsea](location:voidsea).

**Legacy**

Despite having vanished, many in Etrea believed he would still return as far as 600 years after his disappearance. He is also the subject of a prayer meant to ward off evil.
